name: aicodereview
description: Portable code review workflows for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, OpenCode, and Aider

scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run build && node --test tests/node-cli.test.js
scripts.validate: npm run build && node bin/aicodereview.js validate
scripts.generate: npm run build && node bin/aicodereview.js generate --write
scripts.pack:check: npm run clean && npm run build && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build

author: SUDARSHANCHAUDHARI
